title: a reading names its reader
line: a record image is read through the screen's transcription path by a model (llm:<model id>) or a person (user:<name>), every reading here typed from the real image by the harness, in the model's place as llm:harness and in a person's as user:harness: a model with no id, a reader that is neither, a persona with no line or region, and an image not said to be a record or an index are each refused with nothing written; a reading records the model id, the version the id carries, the sha256 of the instruction text and what the image is, and each persona its line or region; a second persona of the same reading keeps its image kind; a person's reading is an extraction of its own

steps.say: page 970 of the 1959 New York marriage index, the real image the 1959 remarriage is read from

seed.collection: New York State Marriage Index, 1881-1967 (Reclaim the Records, Internet Archive)

steps.say: a reading by a model that names no model

expect.why: a model's reading is refused until it names its model
nothing of the refused reading is written, not even its extraction

steps.say: a reading by a session that is neither a model nor a person
a persona the reading places nowhere on the image

expect.why: the refusal names the persona that has no line or region

steps.say: a reading that does not say what the image is
the row of HAHNLE CHRIS M, the 48th line of the page, typed from the image by the harness in the model's place: no model read it, so its reader names the harness

expect.why: the extractor row names the model the reader names, the version its id carries (none: harness carries none) and the hash of the instruction text; the extraction keeps what the image is; the persona its line and its region
the reader is the actor of what its reading writes

steps.say: the next row, said to be a record: this reading says the image is an index

expect.why: what the image is belongs to the reading, and a persona of it never says the other

steps.say: the row of HUMMEL CLIFFO L, the 49th line, by the same reader: a persona of the same reading

expect.why: the same reader under the same instruction adds to its one extraction of the page, the image kind kept from the first persona

steps.say: the row of HOMMELL CHRIST B, the 47th, typed by the harness in a person's place, by the row's region alone

expect.why: a person's reading is an extraction of its own, naming the user and carrying a region instead of a line
